text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: all 16 tests, with no changes to the tests. I made these fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say 5. I set it to 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** the sample data was missing the `Emma` book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. I made up the author, year and copy count. The tests only check the title.
